title: fix(console): offer view management on manage_metadata, not isAdmin alone
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8SBcaWJ4VnpRmSNLW9FDCPD)_

Fixes #36448

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:没有「管理元数据」权限的组织管理员,在列表页不再看到「管理视图」「视图设置」「新建视图」,数据页也不再有「另存为视图」;有该权限的管理员看到的和以前一样。
- 为什么做:这几个入口保存的都是共享视图定义,服务器只接受有「管理元数据」权限的人;以前只看是不是管理员,没权限的管理员点进去一保存就被拒。紧接上一张「只有元数据管理员能建共享视图」的卡。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是有权限的管理员看不到入口(纯界面开关,服务器规则没动),撤回这个改动即恢复。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

One answer gates every entry on a list page that leads to a `view` metadata write: `mayManageViews(isAdmin, useCanAuthorMetadata())` — an administrator whose session holds `manage_metadata`, the capability `PUT`/`DELETE /meta/view/NAME` asks (`metaWriteCapabilityVerdict`). It is the predicate #36398 introduced for the Shared choice (`mayShareViews`), renamed because it now gates more than sharing.

- `ObjectView` computes `canManageViews` once and reads it for: the `ManageViewsDialog` mount, the `ViewConfigPanel` open state and wrapper, the `CreateViewDialog` open state, the title switcher's Add view / Manage views entries (`useObjectViewTitleSwitcher` prop `isAdmin` becomes `canManageViews`), and the plugin view's `allowCreateView` and `viewActions` (settings, share, delete) (`useObjectViewPluginSchema`, same rename).
- `ObjectDataPage`'s Save as view (button, folded menu item and its `CreateViewDialog`) — a fourth Create View door, writing `/meta/view` through `createRuntimeMetadata` — reads the same predicate.
- Declared bounded in-place fix (same defect class, same file, same gate family; named in the thread's first report to the seat): a saved shared view's Rename in the Options menu and Save to this view (`canSaveToSharedView`) both write `/meta/view` through `updateView` and were offered on `isAdmin` alone; they read `canManageViews` too.
- `isAdmin` alone still gates what only reads (the metadata inspector panel, the package-list reads behind the panel's read-only state).

A reader's own views (`sys_personal_view`) are untouched: the in-place Add view still offers My view to everyone who may create one.

## Tests

- New `ObjectView.viewManagementGate-36448.test.tsx`: the real `ObjectView` under the router; an organization administrator without `manage_metadata` gets no Manage views entry (and no dialog); one with it opens Manage views and Create View from it (control); a member gets neither. The plugin schema: without the capability `allowCreateView` is false and `viewActions` empty; with it, both offered (control).
- `ObjectDataPage.saveAsViewRefusal-11578.test.tsx`: new top-level describe in the existing harness — Save as view (button, menu item, dialog) absent without the capability, present with it (control); the existing cases now set the capability explicitly.
- `objectViewViewSharing.test.tsx` and `objectViewRecordNavigation.phonePush-29074.test.tsx` follow the rename.

## Acceptance notes

- none

## Verification

Two-minute check: sign in as an organization administrator who lacks `manage_metadata`, open any object list — the view switcher shows no Manage views and the data page no Save as view; as a metadata administrator both are there.

Riskiest hunks to read first: `ObjectView.tsx` (the `canManageViews` line and the three JSX gates), `objectViewPluginSchema.ts` (`allowCreateView` / `viewActions`), `ObjectDataPage.tsx` (`canSaveAsView`).
